item.title: AIDE
item.description: AIDE (Advanced Intrusion Detection Environment) is a file integrity monitor. It records a baseline of the filesystem — permissions, ownership, size, timestamps, checksums — and a later --check reports every path that has since been added, removed or changed.

item.title: Alert Logic
item.description: The Alert Logic parser for DefectDojo supports imports from CSV format. This document details the parsing of Alert Logic vulnerability scan exports into DefectDojo field mappings, unmapped fields, and transformation notes for easier troubleshooting and analysis.

item.description:
File Types

DefectDojo parser accepts a .json file.

You can generate vulnerability data using the Anchore Enterprise CLI tool, Anchorectl, or through the Enterprise UI.

item.title: Anchore Grype
item.description:
File Types

DefectDojo parser accepts a .json file.

Anchore Grype JSON files are created using the Grype CLI, using the ‘–output=json’ option. See: https://github.com/anchore/grype

item.title: APKLeaks
item.description: APKLeaks scans an Android APK for URIs, endpoints and secrets. It decompiles the package with jadx and then applies a set of named regular expressions — Google_API_Key, Firebase, IP_Address, LinkFinder, and around thirty more — to everything it recovers, including resources and the manifest as well as code.
